title: Wizard Scribe in Study
description: A hooded skeletal wizard in a green cloak sits at a wooden desk writing in a large open book. The magical study is filled with floating scrolls, glowing potion bottles, an ornate hourglass, and hanging lanterns, with a bright stained-glass window in the background.
prompt: A skeletal wizard wearing a green hooded cloak with red lining sits at a large wooden desk inside a gothic study, writing with a quill in an ancient tome. The room is filled with floating enchanted scrolls, colorful glowing potion bottles, an ornate golden hourglass with wings, hanging magical lanterns, and a bright stained glass window depicting an angel. Warm light streams through the window, magical particles float in the air, highly detailed fantasy illustration.
